content:
The Collaborative Laboratory for the Built Environment of the Future

We promote the digital and ecological transition of buildings and infrastructures, making them adaptable, intelligent, resilient and sustainable.

Know More

BIM

Building Information Modeling

With building information modeling it is possible to digitally create one or more precise virtual models of a given construction.

Know More

DIGITALbuilt

BUILT CoLAB, as a member of this Digital Innovation Hub, offers services to SMEs and public administrations at competitive prices that promote innovation, digitalisation and sustainability in the built environment.

Know More

The Mobilizing Project for the Digital Revolution in Construction, to promote an increase in productivity, competitiveness and sustainable growth in the AEC sector.

Know More

Sustainable Buildings & Cities

Sustainable Buildings & Cities

Circular economy strategies, energy efficiency, nature-based solutions in buildings (nZEB) and cities (smart cities). Environmental assessment and solutions to reduce impacts and achieve carbon neutrality. Know More

Industry Decarbonization & Reporting

Industry Decarbonization & Reporting

Life cycle and cost assessment to reduce impacts. Decarbonisation of industry, modularisation and prefabrication strategies, digitalisation and the circular economy. Corporate sustainability reports. Know More

BIM & Point Clouds

BIM & Point Clouds

BIM training and implementation in response to the mandatory methodology. Modelling and parameterisation of models, including digitisation and/or automatic monitoring of construction, based on point clouds. Know More

Digital Twin & IoT

Digital Twin & IoT

Creation of digital models of buildings and infrastructures based on openBIM, with dynamic "virtual" representation and connection to the "physical" world via the Internet of Things, allowing processes to be monitored and improved. Know More

Automation & Artificial Intelligence

Automation & Artificial Intelligence

Development and implementation of advanced solutions designed to automate tasks, optimise processes, provide insights and drive innovation, enabling high levels of productivity and competitiveness to be achieved. Know More

Augmented & Virtual Reality

Augmented & Virtual Reality

Generation of virtual or augmented, immersive and interactive environments, based on openBIM, to support project visualisation, collaboration, progress and quality monitoring, and asset management. Know More
